title_original: Verve Signs 10-Year Lease for Hollywood Headquarters (EXCLUSIVE)

blocks.text: Verve has signed a new 10-year lease for its worldwide headquarters in the Hollywood Media District, marking a significant commitment to the Los Angeles entertainment economy.
Located across from Sunset Las Palmas Studios, Verve’s HQ is situated alongside companies including Netflix, All3Media, Formosa Group, Paramount, SiriusXM and Roc Nation.

Verve commissioned global design collective RIOS to design a headquarters that reflects the agency’s independent culture and ambitions. Its ground-floor theater serves as a meeting place for screenings, press events, conversations with executives and filmmakers and other industry and community programming.

blocks.text: “As the only major talent agency headquartered in Hollywood, we’re proud to deepen our commitment to the Hollywood Media District,” said Verve cofounding partners Adam Levine and Bryan Besser. “This is where the creative process comes to life, among the people whose imagination, creativity and craft make Hollywood what it is. Intentionally making Verve’s long-term home here reflects who we are as advocates for creative talent invested in the future of our industry and the community that drives it. This investment launches Verve’s next decade with the mandate that has defined us from the start: to deliver truly client-first representation built around each client’s individuality and ambition.”

Founded in 2010, Verve is an independent talent and literary agency with operational divisions spanning motion picture literary, television literary, talent, non-fiction, media rights & publishing, Verve Ventures, commercial endorsements and digital. Verve clients include actors like Matthew Lillard, Keith David, Sean Bean, Olivia Thirlby and Eliza Coupe and filmmakers like Sara Hess, Ben Leonberg, Zeb Wells and Adam Stein.
